title: Regular Microwave Setting Faster
text:
Regular Microwave Setting Faster. Followed directions to the letter, potatoes did not cook. Added more time... Potatoes (2) did not cook. Still more time... Nada.
Tried this three different times with normal size potatoes, never cooked.
Put potatoes on plate in microwave, used potato setting and had perfect potatoes! What a waste of time and money for me.

product_metadata.title: Ontel Microwave Cooker, Perfect Potatoes in Just 4 Minutes – As Seen On Tv, Small
features: Cooks all types of potatoes - white, red, yams and more
Cooks Up to 4 potatoes at a time
Also use for corn on the cob, day-old bread, tortillas and more
description: Great for all types of potatoes, corn on the cob, day-old bread, tortillas and more! Creates a steam pocket to cook perfect potatoes in the microwave in just 4 minutes. Delicious, steamy perfect results. Washable and reusable. Perfect for holiday cooking. A great gift idea.
